issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Animal.messageOnFeed() as a public method (+ messageOnFeed(): String), but the solution implementation declares it as protected (protected abstract String messageOnFeed()). This visibility difference is a structural mismatch that may confuse students about the intended access level and could lead to tests or examples expecting a public method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the abstract messageOnFeed() method public in the Animal class to match the UML and the problem description: change its declaration to 'public abstract String messageOnFeed();' in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to indicate a protected visibility if that was intended.
